profile.headline: Software Engineer @ The Hayes Group | Ex-Meta | Typescript - React.js - Node.js - GoLang | Bicycle Enthusiast
profile.summary:
My greatest strength lies in my deep expertise in frontend and full-stack software development, coupled with a proven ability to rapidly learn and adapt to new technologies. I thrive in dynamic environments where I can continuously expand my skill set, and I find that collaboration and mentorship play a crucial role in my professional growth.

As a Developer II at Crema, I played a key role in developing and maintaining applications that supported large-scale organizational restructuring initiatives. A major project involved enhancing a React and D3.js-based visualization tool, enabling companies to better analyze complex organizational structures. I focused on optimizing frontend performance by implementing strategic data-fetching techniques, ensuring faster rendering of key user metrics while adhering to API limitations.

At Meta, I contributed to the development and optimization of multiple supply chain software tools, utilizing technologies such as React, PHP/Hack, and MySQL. I was responsible for modernizing existing tools to align with the company's evolving data center planning strategies. A notable achievement was implementing a dynamic frontend solution that provided hardware engineers with granular control over hardware programs. By migrating previously hardcoded data values to a configurable UI and backend database, I improved flexibility and streamlined planning processes.

You can explore my portfolio at the link below, showcasing my work with React.js, TypeScript, and Material-UI:

www.kylejohnson.xyz

------

Outside of programming, I am also an experienced Collaborative Pianist and Piano Teacher with expertise in Jazz, Classical, and Pop styles. I graduated Millikin University with a Bachelor's Degree in Music Education and I play for several ensembles in the Indianapolis area. I am always open to and enjoy freelance accompanist work.

Utilized Python and Flask to engineer service dispatch pipelines integrating Zoho, Twilio, AWS, and Zapier to send technician work orders and collect signatures and photos of completed jobs.

positions.description:

Developed a user interface for platform administrators, facilitating streamlined management of machine learning classification models.
Maintained and customized features of npm package forks, improving visual aesthetics and enhancing configurability.

Successfully delivered high-priority feature requests within tight timelines and with minimal notice.

positions.title: Software Engineering Immersive Resident
positions.description:
Mentored Junior Engineers struggling with blockers and helped implement solutions that allowed for continued development.

Debugged the codebases of Junior Engineers as needed to assess their personal growth.
Led Junior Engineers to develop an understanding of new libraries, coding best practices, and test development strategies.
Corrected anti-patterns in Junior Engineers' codebases to prevent additional issues in the future.
Measured the performance of Junior Engineers and reported anti-patterns to management when necessary.

projects.title: RevWire.co
projects.description:
RevWire.co is a car news website that aggregates articles from various automotive publications. By leveraging Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Heroku, and the OpenAI API, the platform delivers a seamless and innovative user experience. Key features include:

Automated Content Aggregation: Pulls and organizes articles from multiple trusted automotive sources.
AI-Powered Article Synthesis: Utilizes an OpenAI pipeline to distill and synthesize similar articles, creating concise, original pieces that present the most relevant information.
Scalable Deployment: Deployed on Heroku for reliability and accessibility, ensuring consistent performance.

RevWire.co embodies the intersection of technology and journalism, transforming the way automotive enthusiasts consume news by offering curated and synthesized insights.

projects.title: Overseerr
projects.description:
Contributed to Overseerr, an open-source request management and media discovery tool designed for the Plex ecosystem. Leveraged TypeScript, React, Tailwind, Node.js, and SQLite3 to deliver impactful features, including:

Advanced User Search: Redesigned the backend API to handle query strings, implementing result filtering and pagination to optimize performance and enhance search efficiency.
Status Filtering for TV Series: Developed a status filter for TV series searches, enabling users to sort by status (e.g., ongoing, ended). Enhanced search precision by integrating TMDB proxy requests, significantly improving the user experience.
This experience exemplifies my ability to tackle complex challenges, optimize backend processes, and deliver user-centric features in collaborative open-source environments.
